# dst_port                 — Destination port number
# country_code             — ISO 2-letter country code
# user_agent               — HTTP User-Agent string of client
# login_attempts_last_1h   — Failed login attempts from IP in last 1 hour
# failed_logins_last_24h   — Total failed logins from IP in last 24 hours
# session_duration_sec     — Duration of the session in seconds
# bytes_sent               — Bytes sent by client during session
# bytes_received           — Bytes received by client during session
# num_requests_per_session — Number of HTTP requests made in session
# password_entropy         — Shannon entropy of the attempted password (0-6)
# account_age_days         — Age of target account in days
# is_vpn                   — 1 if traffic appears to come through a VPN
# is_tor_exit_node         — 1 if source IP is a known Tor exit node
# device_fingerprint_match — 1 if device matches account's known device profile
# geo_velocity_kmph        — Estimated impossible travel speed since last login
# new_device               — 1 if login is from a device never seen for account
# captcha_triggered        — 1 if CAPTCHA challenge was issued during session
# login_hour               — Hour of day when login occurred (0-23)
# weekend_login            — 1 if login occurred on a Saturday or Sunday
